The model shows the 1055 × 834 × 967 mm machine envelope and 610 × 610 mm work area. The internal layout is schematic. Do not use the model to locate hidden components for service.

Demonstration job

Engrave “FAB LAB SAGA” on 6 mm plywood, then cut a hole and the outline. Machine time is compressed and the raster rows are spaced wider than real ones so you can see them.

0:00
demo time
  1. 1Close the lid
  2. 2Thickness autofocus
  3. 3Trace with the red dot
  4. 4Raster engraving
  5. 5Vector cutting follows the path slowly
  6. 6The job ends and the head returns home
  7. 7Wait for the smoke to clear before you open the lid
  8. 8Lift the lid and take the part out

The red beam is drawn so you can see it. The real CO₂ beam (10.6 µm) is invisible. Only the red-dot pointer is visible light.
